eb1f4639661e5a27.description: A financial analyst reads and interprets financial and economic data to help businesses and investors make informed decisions and plan for the long term. That means studying historical and current financial data to spot economic trends, and turning that into forecasts and recommendations that shape budget decisions. Financial analysts work across corporations, banks, investment firms, and other financial institutions. About Us Finexa Solutions works in financial services, focused on data-driven insights and strategies that fuel business growth. Our team of 200-plus professionals is built around delivering personalized, attentive service, and our culture rests on integrity, collaboration, and innovation, for our clients and our own people. Employment Type Full-time Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented Financial Analyst to join our growing team and help strengthen the business's financial stability, efficiency, and growth. The role means evaluating financial performance, preparing forecasts, and giving stakeholders insight they can actually act on. Key Responsibilities Work closely with the VP of Finance on forecasting, budgeting, profitability analysis, and reporting. Collect, consolidate, and analyze financial data to evaluate the company's performance and financial standing. Build and maintain financial models, databases, dashboards, and reports, including forecasts and variance analysis, to support decisions and track KPIs. Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end close by reconciling transactions, analyzing variances, and fixing discrepancies. Run benchmarking, process analysis, and business studies to assess past, present, and future performance and surface strategic insight. Stay compliant with financial regulations, company policy, and internal controls while keeping confidential financial data secure. Work with cross-functional teams to assess the financial impact of business initiatives and improve overall productivity. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus. Professional certifications like CPA, CFA, or CMA are an advantage. Skills and Abilities Strong knowledge of accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS), corporate finance, tax regulations, and financial reporting standards. Skilled in financial forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, profitability analysis, and strategy development. Advanced in Excel and MS Office. Familiar with financial software, ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite, and revenue recognition software. Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI, Tableau, and statistical packages. Working knowledge of SQL and Python is a plus. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills, with real accuracy under multitasking. Strong communication, presentation, and reporting ability. Stays current on financial topics, market trends, e-commerce legislation, and the broader business environment. Genuinely committed to continuous learning and professional development. Experience 2 to 5 years in financial analysis, corporate finance, or a related role, ideally in the finance sector. Working Hours Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (some flexibility may be needed around month-end or quarterly reporting). Competitive salary in line with industry standards. Performance-based incentives and an annual bonus. Health insurance and retirement benefits. Room for professional growth. FAQs What are the responsibilities of a Financial Analyst Which is better, CFA or Financial Analyst They are not really comparable, a CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) is a professional certification that adds specialized expertise in investment management, financial analysis, and portfolio management. Financial analyst is the job itself, and it may or may not require a CFA. What skills does a Financial Analyst need A solid grasp of financial modeling, data analysis, and accounting, plus strong Excel skills and familiarity with financial or accounting software. Time management, communication, analytical thinking, accuracy, and problem-solving round out what it actually takes to do the job well. Not strictly, but it helps. A CFA certification signals advanced knowledge and real commitment to the field. Most companies just want a bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field to get started. .

ebd871c69766429d.description:
Location: Bengaluru
Team: Product - Global Broadcast
Experience: 3 years

Why This Role Exists
Cricbuzz's Global Broadcast business brings premium live cricket to audiences across North America, MENA and Southeast Asia through Willow by Cricbuzz and Cricbuzz's international streaming platforms.

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who can help build and continuously improve the products powering our live-streaming business, with a strong focus on delivering a seamless viewing experience, improving consumer journeys and driving subscription and advertising revenue.

From how users discover a match and experience a live stream to how they subscribe, make payments, access support and engage with content, this role will work across the entire streaming product ecosystem.

This is an opportunity for someone who combines product thinking, analytical ability, technical curiosity and a passion for cricket to help shape products used by cricket fans across multiple markets and devices.

What You'll Do
1. Build a Better Live-Streaming Experience
● Identify and develop product features that improve how users discover, access and watch live cricket.
● Work on innovations around live match navigation, multi-language streaming, highlights, quick recaps, key moments, personalised recommendations and interactive viewing experiences.
● Improve the viewing experience across mobile, web, connected TVs and other supported platforms.
● Use product analytics, user feedback and viewing behaviour to identify friction points and opportunities for engagement.
● Collaborate with design and engineering teams to improve player experiences, navigation, content discovery and overall product usability.

2. Own Subscription, Payments & Monetisation Journeys
● Improve subscription discovery, plan selection, checkout, renewal, upgrade and cancellation experiences.
● Work closely with engineering and payment partners to support payment gateway integrations, payment method availability, transaction success rates, refunds and recurring billing.
● Develop and execute product capabilities for discount codes, promotional offers, sale campaigns, free trials and bundled subscription propositions.
● Identify opportunities to reduce payment failures, checkout abandonment and involuntary subscription churn.
● Collaborate with Business, Marketing and Revenue teams to improve subscription conversion, retention and customer lifetime value.
● Support advertising-led monetisation by improving the user experience around ad-supported streaming and relevant ad integrations.

3. Improve Consumer Experience & Support Automation
● Map and optimise critical user journeys, from onboarding and authentication to streaming access, account management and subscription support. ● Identify recurring customer pain points and build product-led solutions that reduce friction and improve customer satisfaction.
● Work on self-service support capabilities, including subscription management, payment troubleshooting, refunds, FAQs and account recovery.
● Explore AI-assisted support workflows, automated ticket classification, response recommendations and intelligent issue resolution.
● Collaborate with Customer Support and Engineering teams to reduce manual intervention, improve resolution times and strengthen the overall consumer experience.

4. Drive Product Execution & Cross-Platform Delivery
● Translate business requirements and consumer insights into clearly defined product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
● Own feature execution from discovery and prioritisation through development, testing, release and post launch evaluation.
● Work closely with Engineering, Design, QA, Streaming Operations, Marketing and Business teams to deliver product improvements.
● Coordinate integrations with third-party technology partners, payment providers and subscription platforms.

5. Own Product Analytics, Experimentation & Growth
● Build and maintain dashboards to track user journeys, feature adoption, subscription funnels and viewing behaviour.
● Identify opportunities to improve conversion and engagement through A/B testing, product experiments and funnel optimisation.
● Evaluate feature performance after launch and recommend improvements grounded in data.
● Use AI tools for research, prototyping, wireframing, analytics and workflow automation to improve product development efficiency.

You'll Thrive If You Have
● 2-3 years of experience in product management, product analytics and consumer technology roles, preferably in OTT, streaming, media, subscription or digital commerce businesses.
● Strong understanding of consumer-facing digital products, user journeys and UX fundamentals.
● Familiarity with subscription platforms, payment gateways, recurring billing, promotional offers and checkout flows.
● An analytical mindset with working knowledge of SQL, Excel, product analytics and experimentation.
● Curiosity about streaming technology, video players, content delivery, mobile apps and connected TV ecosystems.
● Decent UI/UX sense: ability to critique or sketch flows.
● An instinct for identifying friction in consumer journeys and simplifying complex experiences.
● Interest in using AI and automation to improve product functionality and operational efficiency.
● A passion for cricket and an understanding of how fans discover, consume and engage with live sports.

What Success Looks Like
● Better viewing experiences
● Stronger subscription conversion
● Lower customer friction
● Successful product execution At its core, this role is about building a live-streaming product that cricket fans love using, while ensuring that every improvement contributes to a better consumer experience and a stronger streaming business.

ebdbd0c3f0f7befb.description:
About the Role
Sarvam's model APIs (LLM, ASR, TTS, Vision, Translate) are how developers and enterprises ship products on our foundation models. Our OpenAI-compatible LLM APIs route every request across multiple model deployments, with streaming, failover, metering, billing, and rate-limiting all part of the same stack. Today it's FastAPI and Python; we're in the middle of rewriting it in Go.
We're hiring a Software Engineer (SDE 2) to own core parts of this platform. The features. The reliability. The performance. This is an IC role.

What You'll Do
• 
Building and evolving the LLM API platform, from the moment a request hits the edge to the response that goes back out
• 
The Python→Go rewrite: building services in Go alongside the existing Python stack, without compromising reliability
• 
Streaming infrastructure: SSE for Chat Completions and Responses, long-lived connections, clean handling of cancellations and client disconnects
• 
Routing and failover: weighted provider chains, retries with backoff, and latency-driven admission control across model deployments
• 
Protocol compatibility: keeping the API faithful to the OpenAI spec across inference servers (vLLM, SGLang, Dynamo) that each behave slightly differently
• 
The commercial layer: metering, billing, and rate-limiting, engineered to the same bar as the model APIs themselves
• 
Performance and reliability for a multi-tenant platform serving long-context agentic and coding workloads
• 
Observability (logging, metrics, tracing), so the team can debug production confidently and quickly
• 
Integration and load testing: the harness that lets us ship fast without breaking customer-facing APIs
• 
Close partnership with the Inference and MLOps teams on production readiness for new model launches
• 
Design-first, documentation-first engineering culture within the team: RFCs before code, decisions written down, no tribal knowledge

What We're Looking For
• 
3+ years building production backend systems
• 
Strong Python in production: asyncio, FastAPI or similar, and services you've built and operated under real load
• 
Working knowledge of Go, or a strong willingness to learn it: you'll work in both languages through the rewrite
• 
Experience building low-latency, multi-tenant backend services
• 
Hands-on experience with streaming systems: SSE or WebSockets, long-lived connections, backpressure
• 
Strong PostgreSQL and Redis fundamentals: schema design, query performance, caching, and rate limiting
• 
Comfort running services on Kubernetes in production
• 
An ownership mindset: you test before you ship, debug production with metrics, logs, and traces, and write the RCA afterwards

Bonus Points
• 
Experience serving or integrating LLMs in production, especially OpenAI-compatible APIs
• 
Familiarity with inference servers (vLLM, SGLang, Dynamo) and latency metrics such as time to first token and inter-token latency
• 
Experience building metering, billing, or usage-based pricing infrastructure
• 
Time at an early- or growth-stage startup: comfort with ambiguity, speed, and ownership

Why Sarvam?
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
• 
Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
• 
High ownership and high impact, from day one
• 
Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
• 
You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates
If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

Headquarters: United States
 
URL: https://careers.airbnb.com/life-at-airbnb/

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Senior Quality Lead, Volume Tiers is the single accountable leader for quality measurement, insights, and continuous improvement across Airbnb's highest-volume Community Support functions. This role owns the end-to-end quality program for:

• Global English (GE)

• Rest of World (ROW; which is comprised of 9 different languages)

• Elevated Support

GE and ROW span across multiple service tiers: Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, Dedicated Service Support (DSS), Dedicated Managed Host Support (DMHS); supported across a global partner network operating 24/7 in dozens of languages.

The Difference You will Make:

This is a senior leadership role operating at the intersection of strategy and execution. The Senior Quality Lead will break down silos within the Quality organization, establish a unified operating model, and leverage AI-powered tools to scale quality insights. This leader will work closely with Service Delivery, Training, Business Process Improvement, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, remediate issues, and ensure Airbnb is providing its global partner network a unified set of priorities.

The successful candidate will establish themselves as a credible partner to stakeholders and be recognized internally as the voice of quality for the Volume Tier portfolio.

A Typical Day:

Strategic Leadership & Program Ownership

• Own and execute the Volume Tier quality strategy aligned to several critical priorities: breaking silos, aligning with stakeholders, defining a clear operating model, and driving measurable impact.

• Consolidate fragmented QA frameworks across GE and ROW into a unified operating model, eliminating inconsistent processes, divergent NPS detractor approaches, and incompatible quality signals.

• Represent Volume Tier quality in WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and cross-functional planning forums; bring a proactive, narrative-led perspective that gives leadership visibility before problems surface in operational reviews.

Measurement & Quality Execution

• Oversee QA evaluation execution across all Volume Tier partner sites globally, ensuring consistent application of QA processes and frameworks.

• Lead root cause analysis on systemic failures, translating QA findings into product, process, and policy recommendations that go beyond agent-level coaching.

• Formalize Audit the Auditor as an ongoing control: define sample selection, alignment thresholds, root cause review, and evaluator-level remediation processes.

• Ensure every evaluation closes with a documented coaching action; build the tracking mechanisms to measure whether coaching is translating into performance improvement over time.

Insights, Reporting & Stakeholder Partnership

• Establish automated KPI reporting across all Volume Tier sites, tiers, and languages, eliminating manual processes.

• Unify NPS detractor analysis across GE and ROW, ensuring global patterns surface in real time.

• Build a Partner QA Performance Scorecard, establishing clear accountability for Calibration Accuracy, Evaluation Completeness, Critical Error Detection, Coaching Effectiveness.

AI & Technology Enablement

• Lead the deployment of AutoQA (via Observe.AI) across Volume Tiers; partner with the Platform team to ensure appropriate sequencing.

• Build and govern a clear accountability framework for AI-assisted quality tools and processes.

People & Culture Leadership

• Lead a globally distributed team of Partner Quality Leads and Quality Insights Analysts.

• Foster a One-Quality-Team culture that eliminates the cross-team divides: shared best practices, cross-regional learning, and proactive knowledge sharing.

• Set high expectations and hold the team accountable for output quality, insight delivery, and stakeholder engagement.

• Partner closely with peers to ensure one consistent quality voice across the portfolio.

Your Expertise:

• 12+ years of experience in Customer/Community Support, Quality Assurance, or Contact Center Operations, with direct accountability for large-scale, multilingual QA programs.

• 5+ years managing globally distributed QA teams across multiple languages, regions, and partner organizations in a 24/7 support environment.

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience, preferably in related field; MBA or Masters preferred

• Experience with QA tooling platforms, including hands-on ownership of form design, calibration management, and AutoQA deployment.

• Deep expertise in quality methodologies (COPC, AQS, Six Sigma, Lean), with a proven ability to apply them to high-volume, complex support environments.

• Demonstrated track record of leading quality transformation, consolidating fragmented programs, driving measurable improvement in NPS/CSAT, and QA calibrations.

• Experience deploying or scaling AI/ML assisted QA tools (AutoQA, predictive NPS/CSAT).

• Strong executive presence: able to influence senior stakeholders, present a unified quality narrative in leadership forums, and drive alignment across stakeholders.

• Experience managing vendor partner governance: calibration oversight, performance improvement plans, and escalation frameworks.

Preferred

• COPC certification; Six Sigma Green or Black Belt.

• Experience with Observe.AI.

• Background in program management, change management, or organizational design within a high-growth tech environment.

• Experience working in or closely with BPO/vendor governance models at scale (1,000+ partner FTEs across multiple sites and geographies).

Your Location:

This position is Canada - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a province where Airbnb Canada, Inc. has a registered entity. Currently we can hire in the following provinces: Ontario, British Columbia, Quebec, Alberta, and Saskatchewan. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with your recruiter on what provinces you are eligible to work from.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

We use automated tools to help our recruiting team efficiently screen a large volume of applications. All final hiring decisions are made by a human reviewer.

This role is newly created and does not replace or backfill an existing position.

Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager – Foundation Pillar

Team: Product Marketing
Reports to: VP, Product Marketing

About the Role

6sense is the GTM Intelligence Platform, and Foundation is the layer the rest of it stands on — "platform, data, infrastructure: the backbone everything builds on." It owns account and people data, matching and identity, the APIs and MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and the workflows that move data through the system. When buyers ask whether 6sense is accurate, extensible, secure, and composable, the answer lives here.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager to own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for the Foundation pillar. This is the most technical seat on the PMM team. You'll translate deep capabilities — identity resolution, data coverage and accuracy, API extensibility, the MCP framework, security and compliance — into differentiated stories that win over the technical and economic buyers who scrutinize them: RevOps architects, IT and security teams, data leaders, and increasingly developers building agentic GTM stacks.

You'll also carry one of the most strategically important narratives in the company: that 6sense is a composable intelligence layer other systems and AI agents plug into — "AI to the data, not data to the AI" — rather than a closed destination. With the MCP framework moving to GA, this is a present-tense story, and you'll be the one who tells it credibly.

What You'll Own

• Positioning and messaging for the Foundation pillar — platform, data, infrastructure, identity and matching, APIs and the MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and workflows. You set the narrative and keep it coherent with the Intelligence and Activation pillars.

• Technical proof. Turn capability into credibility: architecture explainers, technical briefs and whitepapers, benchmarks, and reference narratives that substantiate the "backbone everything builds on" claim — especially around data accuracy, coverage, and identity resolution.

• The composable / MCP-agent story. Own the infrastructure-layer narrative — 6sense as the data and intelligence layer that agentic GTM stacks compose with. Lead GTM for the MCP framework and the developer / technical-buyer audience it opens up.

• Differentiation for the data and identity layer. Make the case against point data providers and infrastructure alternatives — coverage, match rates, identity quality, enrichment, security posture — and arm the field to win on it.

• Field and partner enablement for technical evaluations. Build the battlecards, objection handling, FAQs, and solution content that win RFPs, security reviews, and technical POCs. Partner with Sales Engineering to make the technical buyer's diligence a place 6sense wins.

• Launches. Drive end-to-end GTM for Foundation releases: new data assets, API and MCP capabilities, security packages (SCIM, SSO role mapping, audit, custom roles), connectors, and workflow features.

• Cross-functional partnership. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Foundation Product and Engineering leaders to shape roadmap-to-market, and with Customer Success to surface the post-sale and admin/security use cases that prove the platform's breadth.

• Market and competitive intelligence for the data and platform layer, feeding insight back into roadmap and pricing/packaging conversations.

What You'll Bring

• 8+ years in product marketing, technical product management, or a closely related function, with substantial technical PMM experience for platform, data, infrastructure, API, or developer products.

• A proven ability to translate technical concepts — APIs, data pipelines, identity resolution, integrations, security, and AI/agent architectures like MCP — into crisp positioning and business value, without losing the engineers in the room or the buyers outside it.

• A track record owning messaging for technical products and enabling technical sales motions (Sales Engineering, RFPs, security reviews, POCs).

• Hands-on, not hand-wavy. You'll personally call the APIs, stand up and configure the MCP server, connect it to an agent, and build the demo — and your messaging is sharper because you've done the thing, not just read the spec.

• Strong writing — you can produce content that is technically rigorous and genuinely clear, from a one-line value prop to an architecture whitepaper.

• Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, or data platforms, and comfort selling to technical and economic buyers (RevOps architects, IT, security, data teams, developers).

• The judgment and presence to operate as a senior individual contributor: set strategy, lead cross-functionally without authority, and influence product and executive stakeholders.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on familiarity with data enrichment and identity (waterfall enrichment, matching, intent data), MCP and agentic AI architectures, or composable/API-first platforms.

• Experience marketing to developers or technical evaluators, including documentation-adjacent and developer-community work.

• Background in or adjacent to GTM intelligence, ABM, sales intelligence, CDP, iPaaS, or identity platforms.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, Foundation has a differentiated, defensible position that technical buyers recognize; the composable/MCP infrastructure story is landed with the field and the market as something that exists today, not a roadmap promise; the data and identity credibility story is substantiated with proof, not assertion; and the field has the enablement to win the technical evaluation every time it comes.

Base Salary Range: $183,044.00 - $205,035. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board.
